summary: This note describes the broadcast arrangement of Live with Kelly and Ryan, a daytime talk show produced in New York City. It explains that the show airs live at 9 a.m. Eastern Time on weekdays and is tape-delayed elsewhere, that it is associated with ABC but is also syndicated to other networks' stations in many markets, and how its ABC timeslot on owned stations changed over time, including WLS Chicago's scheduling history and the show's earlier run on WGN.
one_line: Overview of Live with Kelly and Ryan's live New York broadcast schedule, ABC station carriage, and timeslot history across markets.
key_facts: Live with Kelly and Ryan is broadcast live from New York City on weekdays at 9 a.m. for stations in the Eastern Time Zone.
The show is tape-delayed for the rest of the country.
Live with Kelly and Ryan is generally associated with the ABC network and airs on all ABC owned-and-operated stations.
In many markets, Live with Kelly and Ryan is syndicated to stations affiliated with other networks.
Live with Kelly and Ryan did not air in a morning timeslot on all ABC-owned stations until September 2013.
WLS Chicago programmed the 9 a.m. timeslot with The Oprah Winfrey Show as the originating station in the 1980s.
After the end of The Oprah Winfrey Show, WLS Chicago programmed the 9 a.m. timeslot with Windy City Live.
The New York-based Live had aired on The CW affiliate WGN since 2002.
WLS had carried Live with Kelly and Ryan in an overnight timeslot earlier in its run.
The note describes the show's distribution as tied to ABC owned-and-operated stations and syndication to other networks' affiliates.
